story.fullStory:
The Beatles's "If I Fell" reached #53 on the Billboard Hot 100. "If I Fell" is a song by English rock band the Beatles which first appeared in 1964 on the album A Hard Day's Night in the United Kingdom and United States, and on the North American album Something New.

The song peaked at #53 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 9 weeks on the chart.

If I Fell was released in 1964.

Album: A Hard Day's Night (Soundtrack) (1964).
